chunks: From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Muthanna, from Abu Basir, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Allah will surely assist this matter (the cause of the Imam) through those who have no religion/faith, and if our command were to come, those who are today established in idol worship would emerge from it.'

key_terms.عِبَادَةُ ٱلۡأَوۡثَانِ: Idol worship (metaphorically used for spiritual stagnation or lack of true guidance)
key_terms.لَا خُلَاقَ لَهُۥ: He has no religion/faith (literally: no 'khuluq' or moral/religious character)
key_terms.ٱلۡأَمْرُ: The matter/cause (referring to the Imam's leadership and victory)

ai.seo_question: Who will assist Imam Mahdi (a.s.) upon his reappearance according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the divine guarantee of victory for Imam Mahdi (a.s.) through a diverse group of followers, specifically those who may not be strictly defined by conventional religious labels or who have transitioned from idolatry. It underscores the theme of spiritual purification and the emergence of the faithful from among those currently engaged in 'worship of idols' (whether literal or metaphorical), ensuring the cause's success despite initial appearances of weakness.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 454 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ali bin Hakam from Muthanna from Abu Basir that he said:

Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Almighty Allah will assist Imam Mahdi (a.s) through people who have no religion and faith. When he reappears, there will be people who had till date been idolaters, but they will give up idolatry and join the Imam.”
